title: Adjudicated reason label (evaluator-only)
description: One adjudicated answer for one cohort case: the defect mechanism the later fix actually repaired, or the finding that there was none. This is oracle material under system-design.md §13 — it must never reach a reviewer, an engine-visible path, or either coder role (coder-miner, coder-engine-runner). The miner defines this schema and never populates it: `RetrospectiveEvidence` in a cohort record is raw signals, which are input to adjudication, not the adjudicated answer (docs/h1-pre-registration.md, 'Oracle and reason label'). One JSON object per case; a labelled cohort is a JSONL of these next to the cohort it labels, never inside it. Fields the pre-registration names as the minimum are required; the rest are optional and exist so a judge can trace the label back to the evidence it rests on.

repository.description: owner/repo, copied from the cohort case.

pr.description: Original PR number, copied from the cohort case.

cohort_records_sha256.description: records_sha256 of the cohort manifest this label belongs to. A label is only meaningful against the exact record set it was adjudicated on; re-sampling the cohort invalidates the binding.

verdict.description: The adjudicated class. It may disagree with the cohort case's sampler_label — the sampler applies a rule over raw signals, the adjudicator reads the evidence — and a disagreement is a finding about the sampler, recorded in `notes`, not silently reconciled.

mechanism.description: Free text: the defect mechanism the later fix repaired, stated at the level a reviewer's stated reason is matched against (docs/h1-pre-registration.md, 'reason match'). Required when verdict is RISKY; absent when CLEAN.

subsystem.description: Exactly one subsystem tag. Defaults to the cohort case's cell.subsystem; the adjudicator may override it when the dominant changed path is not where the defect lives.

category.description: Exactly one invariant-or-mechanism category, by `id`, from the closed list in the sibling categories document (schemas/reason-label-categories.schema.json). The list is built while labelling the first ten cases, not designed up front, so this schema does not enumerate values; the categories document is the authority, and a label whose category is not in it is invalid. Required when verdict is RISKY.

system_level_escape.description: Whether the escape surfaced past review and CI — in system test, warm-restart/upgrade, scale, interop, or the field — as opposed to a lint-class defect. Positives in H1 are meant to be system-level; a RISKY case marked false here is a selection finding.

evidence_refs.description: source_ref values (commit SHAs, PR or issue numbers) from the case's RetrospectiveEvidence that the adjudicator relied on. Provenance for the label, not a substitute for `mechanism`.

adjudicator.description: Who adjudicated. A person or a named judge configuration; never a reviewer arm.

notes.description: Free text: uncertainty, sampler disagreement, or why a category was added to the closed list on this case.
